decisions.decision: Both blockers are cleared. T-147 is done: the app runs at usetantra.com. Drop Sales Navigator and do not wait on T-260. Build the list now from the client-list reuse lane Adi asked for on 2026-09-17, plus any vendor-delivered prospect CSVs already on disk. Only read and export from client sources; change nothing in those accounts. Remove duplicates, clean the CSV, run free non-email checks only, and drop any contact without a work email. Import the list into Tantra at usetantra.com as the contact list 'Workshop cold calendar'. Write the per-upload limit shown on the import screen into this task's log. Then create a calendar-invite campaign (its own campaign type, not a sequence step) against that list. Use the FintechCircle service-account senders already uploaded. Leave the campaign in draft and do not start it. Finally, unblock T-058.
